findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Documents/PDFs are generated client-side (jspdf) and transmitted to recipients via user-initiated email sharing (api/enviar.js POST endpoint) or Android Share Sheet (Capacitor Share). Exempt from prominent disclosure per Case 3 but must be declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.
findings.evidence: api/enviar.js (lines 17-56): PDF base64 data is POSTed to serverless API endpoint when user explicitly fills recipient email and triggers send. DocumentShareModal.tsx (lines 205-257): handleSendEmail generates PDF, then sends via api/enviar.js. vendor-pdf-J-Nz47Vc.js: jspdf PDF generation library (client-side only). index-BMHFFNQZ.js: localStorage used for Supabase auth session persistence (local only).
findings.recommendation: Declare 'App functionality - Email document sharing' in Play Store Data Safety section for FILES_AND_DOCS under user-initiated data collection (Case 3: transferred, user-initiated, first-party).

findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Receipt/purchase data stored locally in Dexie (IndexedDB) is synced to Supabase backend when user clicks 'Sincronizar com a Nuvem' button in Dashboard. Exempt from prominent disclosure per Case 3 but must be declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.
findings.evidence: syncService-DcwUexvy.js: Reads receipt data (type, number, date, client_name, items, total, etc.) from local Dexie database where userId matches, then upserts to Supabase 'documents' table via first-party backend. App.tsx (lines 128-143): handleSync is bound to Dashboard sync button. Dashboard.tsx (lines 133-139): User clicks 'Sincronizar com a Nuvem' to trigger sync. User must be online (isConnected check) and explicitly initiate sync.
findings.recommendation: Declare 'App functionality - Cloud sync and backup' in Play Store Data Safety section for PURCHASE_HISTORY under user-initiated data collection (Case 3: transferred, user-initiated, first-party).
